answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, expired if not renewed by fresh work, rewards vest against future work. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Reaching the yarrow of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The bridge is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the hollow. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
